remarks: This charming updated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom single-family home for rent in Norwalk offers modern living in a peaceful neighborhood. The home features an extra room that can be used as an office, playroom, or guest space, providing added flexibility for your needs. Both bathrooms have been fully updated with stylish finishes, and the kitchen has been recently renovated with white cabinetry, sleek countertops, and new stove. The bright and open layout makes the home feel welcoming and perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. Enjoy a large backyard and a location that's close to shopping, dining, and public transportation, making it easy to experience all that Norwalk has to offer. Don't miss the opportunity to make this charming house your next home!
